title: Stellar-age-anchored inverse distance ladder: analysis code and plotting samples
description: Compact analysis and plotting source code, frozen configurations, observational inputs, posterior summaries and validation records for a conditional stellar-age inverse distance ladder with Pantheon+ and DESI DR2. GC25 is primary; GC26 is an alternative. Posterior sample arrays are supplied separately in a version-matched archive; full raw chains and the unpublished manuscript are excluded.
